items.title: EvoClawBench: Can Agents Learn Reusable Skills from Their Own Runs?
items.title_zh: EvoClawBench：智能体能否从自身运行中学习可复用技能？
items.summary: Introduces a benchmark that isolates whether an agent runtime can turn evidence from its own runs into reusable skills, with 100 tasks and 502 sub-problems across coding, data, office, security, operations, and document workflows; self-authored skills had mixed effects, including one pairing that dropped from 77.77% to 4.80% under PreSkill.

items.title: Forget to Improve: On-Device LLM-Agent Continual Learning via Budget-Curated Memory
items.title_zh: 以遗忘求改进：端侧LLM智能体基于预算策展记忆的持续学习
items.summary: Proposes a single net-value-per-byte score that governs an on-device agent's experience-memory lifecycle, deciding what to keep under RAM and energy budgets, what to share over a thin uplink, and what to trust by provenance; on task-drift benchmarks and a Jetson testbed it cuts memory 2.7x and uplink 2.4x, drives injection success from 0.75 to zero, and improves accuracy on cases corrupted by poison or stale memory.

items.title: RAVEN: Long-Horizon Reasoning & Navigation with a Visuo-Spatio-Temporal Memory
items.title_zh: RAVEN：面向长程推理与导航的视觉-时空记忆
items.summary: An agentic memory system for long-horizon robot question answering and navigation that stores visual embeddings with pose and time in a vector database and grounds retrieval in a spatial map; it avoids lossy image-to-text captioning, surpasses caption-based memory systems on simulated and real benchmarks, and matches frontier VLMs at 10x lower retrieval cost.

items.title: Agents Don't Paginate: First-Chunk Selection for LLM Tool Responses
items.title_zh: 智能体不翻页：LLM工具响应的首块选择
items.summary: Observes that coding agents never request a second chunk of oversized tool responses, then treats first-chunk selection as a 0/1 knapsack over 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks; raising precision-at-1 does not systematically raise downstream accuracy, with per-model deltas under three points, because agents recover the gold item from anywhere in the chunk.

items.title: SHERLOC: Structured Diagnostic Localization for Code Repair Agents
items.title_zh: SHERLOC：面向代码修复智能体的结构化诊断定位
items.summary: A training-free framework that pairs a reasoning LLM with compact repository tools and self-recovery for fault localization; it reaches 84.33% accuracy@1 on SWE-Bench Lite and 81.27% recall@1 on SWE-Bench Verified, and injecting its locations and diagnostic findings into repair agents yields an average +5.95-point resolve-rate gain while cutting localization tokens by 36.7%.

items.title: LLM-Based Scientific Peer Review: Methods, Benchmarks, and Reliability Challenges
items.title_zh: 基于LLM的科学同行评审：方法、基准与可靠性挑战
items.summary: Surveys LLM-based scientific peer review with a taxonomy spanning prompt-based, supervised, retrieval-augmented, and alignment-optimized approaches, and analyzes dataset constraints, evaluation shortcomings, domain bias, and robustness risks including prompt injection, data poisoning, retrieval vulnerabilities, and reward hacking.

items.title: SoK: AI Secure Code Generation: Progress, Pitfalls, and Paths Forward
items.title_zh: SoK：AI安全代码生成——进展、陷阱与前路
items.summary: Systematizes AI secure code generation with a three-level framework covering natural-language understanding of secure-coding principles, code-level actuation, and the knowledge-actuation gap; across models and coding agents, principle understanding strongly predicts functional and security outcomes, yet models often recognize principles without translating them into secure, functional code.

items.title: Life After Benchmark Saturation: A Case Study of CORE-Bench
items.title_zh: 基准饱和之后：CORE-Bench案例研究
items.summary: Argues that retiring a benchmark when accuracy saturates misses six other dimensions of agent performance, including construct validity, out-of-distribution generalization, efficiency, reliability, model-versus-scaffold importance, and human-agent collaboration; it releases CORE-Bench v1.1 plus an OOD suite, and a small randomized experiment finds human-agent collaboration roughly twice as fast.

items.title: NVIDIA-NeMo/labs-molt
items.title_zh: NVIDIA-NeMo/labs-molt：面向研究的智能体优先强化学习框架
items.summary: NVIDIA NeMo's labs-molt is a roughly 9,000-line Python reinforcement learning framework for research, described as scalable, agentic-first, and HuggingFace-native.

items.title: VibeThinker: 3B param model that beats Opus 4.5 on reasoning with novel SFT+GRPO
items.title_zh: VibeThinker：30亿参数模型凭全新SFT+GRPO在推理上超越Opus 4.5
items.summary: A technical report introduces VibeThinker-3B, a 3B-parameter dense model trained with curriculum-based supervised fine-tuning, multi-domain reinforcement learning, and offline self-distillation; it reports 94.3 on AIME26, 97.1 with claim-level test-time scaling, and 80.2 Pass@1 on LiveCodeBench v6.
